pilot.reason: Four ambiguity prompts already had an explicit discourse focus and therefore did not validly require abstention. They were replaced with unbound multi-action questions before any product repair.

repair_progression: 23/24 after explicit topic and same-turn relation integration

mechanisms: Event-sequence ordinal references carry an inherited goal ID into the typed action-state analyzer.
The inherited goal ID disambiguates actions that share a predicate without granting new execution authority.
Explicit topic return can bind Korean and English deictic action reports to the unique matching active goal.
Same-turn attribution actor coreference is bounded to a named actor followed by a reporting attitude and is disabled inside quotes.
Same-turn causal and temporal connectors create dialogue-relation evidence only; causal truth and semantic authority remain false.
Verified-execution realization cites both the selected action ID and accepted typed receipt IDs.
Unbound multi-action status questions preserve ambiguity and fail closed instead of selecting the most recent action.
residual_limits: This is a bounded deterministic Language Cortex, not unrestricted GPT-level language competence.
Open-vocabulary paraphrase, broad implicature, humor, social repair, and unrestricted Korean morphology remain incomplete.
Longer adversarial multi-speaker conversations and bridging or plural reference need broader frozen transfer suites.
Tool-specific structured result payloads still need dedicated provenance extractors.
The internal evidence seal does not prove the truth of an external source.
next_program_order: broader open-vocabulary and adversarial paraphrase transfer across the integrated six-axis path
longer multi-speaker discourse with conflicting speakers, repairs, topic returns, and plural or bridging reference
tool-specific result payload provenance without expanding language into semantic authority
